gen-gf-tektur-gf-piazzolla: Wiry, oversized, and a bit techy: Tektur draws its lowercase big with pipe-cleaner strokes and open curve ends. Piazzolla, the text serif below, has an opened-up e and a refined, authoritative voice.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-scope-one: Tektur brings oversized lowercase and pipe-cleaner strokes, its horizontals matching its verticals in weight. And Scope One, with stubby ascenders beside a tall x-height, would read in sturdy, traditional fashion over pages.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, with generously open counters. Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes never vary in width, and that unwavering line set against the text serif is the pair's whole appeal.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-suwannaphum: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes have a signage-like plainness, with outsized lowercase and wide curve openings. Suwannaphum adds a serif with a tall, squared-off x-height and an open c, so the two read dignified and editorial together.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One has a literary, dignified look, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. But Tilt Neon's tube-like strokes of constant width give the heading a bold, commanding glow up top.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-kadwa: Tilt Neon draws every letter with an uninterrupted tube-like line and a splayed c terminal. Kadwa, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, is the pair's real strength: classic and editorial in tone.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-piazzolla: Tube-like lines, big lowercase: Tilt Neon steadies every curve like a technical pen. Piazzolla, the text serif, keeps its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, refined and authoritative beside the heading's tubes.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-pridi: A flat, tube-like line of constant weight defines Tilt Neon. It makes bold, commanding statements, while Pridi spends its generous curve openings and proud, almost capital-sized lowercase on classic, refined text.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads as editorial and traditional, its terminals stopping far from the stem and its letters generously spaced. Turret Road's round, parenthesis-like forms and pen-like line are the pair's loudest voice.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Padyakke Expanded One spreads wide, each c a pitcher's mouth. Its round bowls keep walls of constant weight, so paragraphs move slowly and literary, while Underdog's horseshoe-shaped c adds its own expressive punch up top.
